title: Parsing a JSON string
description: You can follow serialized text into a Python dictionary.

steps.description: json_string holds JSON text inside a Python string. You can read name, age and city in that text.

steps.question: Does loads open a file to obtain this data?
steps.answer: No. It parses the string passed directly as its argument.

steps.description: You store the parsed object in data. This JSON object becomes a Python dictionary.
The print displays the dictionary with John, 30 and New York. You now have structured Python values rather than the original serialized string.
